title: v1.52.0 Failed to connect to Tailscale service
body:
### What is the issue?

---------------------------
Tailscale Error
---------------------------
Failed to connect to Tailscale service.



Version 1.52.0 (t3c2ff1e4a-gfccfad18e)



LogID: d7215ddcb08bb19ce0ab4ea8bcfa79f9bee1ba3764701c131f3cd9fc888038c9

(Ctrl-C to copy this text)


---------------------------
确定   
---------------------------


### Steps to reproduce

Normally start tailscale service (or after reboot)

### Are there any recent changes that introduced the issue?

After updated from 1.51.0 to 1.52.0, this bug occurs.

### OS

Windows

### OS version

Windows 10

### Tailscale version

1.52.0

### Other software

zerotier
clash for windows

### Bug report

d7215ddcb08bb19ce0ab4ea8bcfa79f9bee1ba3764701c131f3cd9fc888038c9

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
@participant1 The investigation cannot proceed because the tailscale GUI is not open source. Here's the situation: if I uninstall tailscale v1.5.20 and use `go install` to install tailscaled, it works fine and uses the `wintun.dll` in the application directory.  

However, once I install tailscale v1.5.20, everything changes - the loaded DLL is a different version located in `system32`. The strangest thing is that "process monitor" shows tailcaled loading an image from the application directory, but tailscaled prints out the old version number.  

tailscaled crashes because `wintun.dll` v1.3 has a different `log callback` with only two parameters, whereas the new version has three parameters and includes a `timestamp`, which does not exist in the old version of the DLL.  

Perhaps we should check the `wintun.dll` version in tailscaled codebase.
